description.narrative: The funding objective is to develop and scale BG’s leadership organization through the funding of 250 senior extension officers within the organization to participate in the Intensive Leadership Development Program (ILDP) in 2018 and 2019. The scaling is necessary to expand BG’s agricultural franchise model and reach at least 50,000 additional smallholder farmers by 2019. This is part of a broader effort to increase the food security of 1 million smallholder farmers living in Northern Nigeria by 2025.
